batch097
Snapshot: Candidate 52dba11d22104b43cbc333412c6c3c387961285c; frozen EN 6af98cb717755690a9ca793e5454a96ebd7a8f9f; accepted RU 90e41299dc983d315af46fb6e6793df890c90dda. Opening and closing gates completed with exit 0 and identical bound-scope SHA256 c97446fcfde38c73f40eff8eff75387ba805d1c1b5ca86eb1458438207568330. Candidate 2176 objects; accepted baseline 2170 preserved; three new strokes reported raw-identical. No additional uncommitted runtime changes surfaced by the gates.
Scope: All 57 assigned content windows returned completely, each with its RETURNED trailer and exit 0; both gates also completed. Read all four current RU guidance documents and three rubrics; complete EN/RU 合, 君, 命 lessons; all 20 EN/current-RU context pairs; EN-only words/命.md; all 15 KANJIDIC2 records, radical evidence, provider header, 66 whole ordered JMdict entries and three captured KanjiPedia visible entries; all 334 current typed kanji rows; nine proposals, three lesson adjudications, three clarifications, three outside-limit observations, signed amendment and all ten exact navigation diffs. Total teaching bodies: 24 EN and 23 RU. No failed/unread assigned windows.
C1 CLEAN (three new lessons, bounded evidence): Readings, okurigana notation, 6/7/8 strokes and classical 口/30 agree with official evidence. The frozen community N3 classification is retained, not confused with KANJIDIC2's historical JLPT values. Examples and distinctions are supported; mnemonic labels explicitly avoid etymological claims. No confirmed Japanese factual defect.
C2 UNVERIFIED (ordinary active-negative quiz safety); CLEAN (bounded scope/navigation): Ten edits are precisely the authorized wrappers, with visible Japanese/Russian prose, metadata and old links preserved. New lessons link only to available assigned RU word/kanji files; unavailable words/命.md is not linked or imported. All nine directed comparisons are supported at introductory/source-core scope, with no attested overlap between the particular foil titles and target senses in the supplied evidence. This does not establish the executing quiz's prompt/reading restriction or fallback safety. No confirmed correctable scope/link defect.
C3 CLEAN (three new lessons and wrapper readability): Russian explanations are understandable without English; address restrictions, verb contrasts and life-versus-livelihood distinctions are explicit. Sections and reading tables are coherent. Wrappers preserve every visible label, including whole 合う. No confirmed Russian comprehension defect.
N001合→台 S-intro; ordinary U: 台 title «подставка; счётное слово для техники» is not fitting/joining. 合's units, sums and counters (1956260) and 台's counters/ranges (1412560) share a quantitative domain, not this actual answer sense; 2036120 adds tower/pedestal/calyx. Not unrestricted guard approval.
N002合→古 S-intro; ordinary U: «старый; древний» is not an attested 合 sense. Checked 合's joining, meeting, correctness, profitability and auxiliary uses (1284430), plus its noun/suffix entries, against 古's antiquity/used/old senses (1265040/1265060/1265070). No reverse inference.
N003合→名 S-intro; ordinary U: «имя» is not established for 合. 名's title/reputation/pretext and people-counter/name uses (1531330/2153790) do not turn 合's units/counters/sum into a name. Shared counter status alone is not semantic equality.
N004君→古 S-intro; ordinary U: «старый; древний» is distinct from 君's address, ruler/master, historical third-person and name/family-suffix senses (1247250/1247260/2697530/2697540); 古's secondary senses do not supply this answer for 君.
N005君→右 S-intro; ordinary U: «правый; справа» is not an attested 君 sense. 右's right hand, above-mentioned, political right and better-of-two senses (1171010) were considered; status/ruler associations do not establish the directional answer.
N006君→書 S-intro; ordinary U: «писать» does not describe 君's attested senses. 書's writing/drawing, book/document, calligraphy/handwriting and literary letter/learning senses (1343950/2037940/1505080) remain distinct; judged independently of N004/N005.
N007命→会 S-intro; ordinary U: «встречаться; встреча» is not established for 命. 命's life/lifespan/core, command/fate and みこと honorific/archaic address senses (1531940/1584630/1604460/1694240) were considered against 会's gathering/association/encounter senses (1198160/1198170/1198180).
N008命→今 S-intro; ordinary U: «сейчас» is not an attested 命 meaning. 今's just-now/soon/immediately/more/current-prefix senses (1288850/1288860) do not equate a present moment with 命's life or lifespan. Temporal association is insufficient.
N009命→同 S-intro; ordinary U: «одинаковый; тот же» is not an attested 命 meaning. 同's same/said/likewise and agreement/equality senses (1451730/1451750 and KANJIDIC2) do not supply this answer for life, command, fate or honorific address.
L001合 SUPPORTED, introductory scope: Frozen facts and fit/join theme retained; selected expanded examples supported. Modern-shape image is explicitly mnemonic.
L002君 SUPPORTED, introductory scope: Familiar きみ, name-suffix くん and ruler meanings remain separate; -ぎみ is supported; no English-you dependency or absolute gender/politeness rule.
L003命 SUPPORTED, introductory scope: Life/command distinction and 寿命/生活 contrasts retained; optional missing word link correctly removed without adopting that word.
A001 SUPPORTED, bounded: 1284430 is godan/intransitive in matching use; 1284480 ichidan/transitive; 1284460 separate godan/transitive 合わす. 1285100 supports ガッ in 合致. 会う contrast is contextual, not a denial of 合う's meeting sense; ごう unit note is accurate.
A002 SUPPORTED, bounded: 1247250/1247260 support the stated interpersonal qualifications; 2697530 supports respectful -ぎみ for someone else's family members. Dictionary descriptions are not universal recommendations; omitted きんじ is not declared impossible.
A003 SUPPORTED, bounded: 1531940 and 1584630 distinguish いのち from command-bearing めい; 1330240 supports object service life, 1378860 livelihood. Additional readings/senses are not silently imported into frozen metadata or denied.
NAV01 words/一生懸命.md: CLEAN; line 30 wraps only 命 to ../kanji/命.md.
NAV02 words/具合.md: CLEAN; line 28 wraps only 合 to ../kanji/合.md; あい preserved.
NAV03 words/割合.md: CLEAN; line 30 wraps only 合 to ../kanji/合.md.
NAV04 words/合う.md: CLEAN; line 32 wraps only 合 to ../kanji/合.md.
NAV05 words/合図.md: CLEAN; line 30 wraps only 合 to ../kanji/合.md; existing 図 link and visible text preserved.
NAV06 words/君.md: CLEAN; line 31 wraps only 君 to ../kanji/君.md.
NAV07 words/場合.md: CLEAN; line 26 wraps only standalone 合 to ../kanji/合.md; separate existing 合い unchanged.
NAV08 words/試合.md: CLEAN; line 28 wraps only 合 to ../kanji/合.md; ateji explanation unchanged.
NAV09 words/都合.md: CLEAN; line 32 wraps only 合 to ../kanji/合.md; ゴウ preserved.
NAV10 words/間に合う.md: CLEAN; line 32 wraps the complete existing label 合う to ../kanji/合.md exactly as the pre-mutation amendment authorizes. This intentionally navigates to the kanji lesson, not the word article; no split or visible-text change.
Outside LIMIT dispositions: O001 SUPPORTED as limitation, not guard approval: supplied senses expose broader joining/meeting/quantification domains; notably 合's meeting sense can overlap current 会 «встречаться; встреча» if sampled as a fallback. O002 SUPPORTED as limitation: 君's master/ruler senses raise a direct concern with current 主 «хозяин; главный»; 命's archaic みこと address does not prove ordinary modern synonymy. O003 SUPPORTED as limitation: 命 and current 生 share «жизнь»; naming/fate domains warrant separate pair evidence. 令 is not a current typed provider, and accepted 生活 does not create 活. No outside guard, reverse edge or transitive closure approved.
Findings: none confirmed within the assigned change scope. Ordinary runtime safety remains unresolved, not converted into CLEAN by metadata retention or author checks.
Optional: In kanji/合.md, Примечания, add full readings 友達に会う（ともだちにあう） and サイズが合う（サイズがあう） for easier beginner decoding; this is helpful polish, not a demonstrated factual defect.
Limits: Read only supplied captures; no web_fetch pages read. KanjiPedia radical images/pixels were not inspected; radical identity uses KANJIDIC2 and Unicode evidence. No tests, builds, validators, git, writes or delegation performed. Gates bind the snapshot; author's mechanical results are not my validation credit. All 334 rows were read as metadata, not as 334 full lessons or exhaustive official sense inventories. Actual quiz execution, question-mode restrictions and fallback selection were not supplied/read; all nine ordinary active-negative dispositions remain U, and identified outside-domain overlaps are not resolved by introductory comparisons. No full-corpus, native-speaker, frequency/necessity, learning-outcome, media/device, publication or activation approval.
